variantgroups.description: Defines groups of variants that get combined to produce the final set of item/block codes.

code.description: Identifier for this variant group, used as the {code} placeholder in the item/block code pattern

states.description: A list of all the valid states for this variant.

combine.description: How this variant combines with other variant types to create individual objects.

loadFromProperties.description: If set, copies a WorldProperties asset to create variants from.

loadFromPropertiesCombine.description: A set of world properties to combine to create variants from
